name: vencap-mcp-client
description: Query VenCap portfolio data via the central VenCap MCP server.
long_description: This extension is a thin forwarder only. It holds no database credentials. Your API key is stored using this computer's secure credential storage and is attached to requests automatically. All requests are sent over the internal VenCap network to the central MCP server on VEN-W11D-AUTO, which performs all query validation, schema access checks, and audit logging. Requires VPN or office network.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Query VenCap portfolio data. Only SELECT statements are permitted; enforced centrally.

central_server_url.title: VenCap MCP Server Address
central_server_url.description: Internal address of the central VenCap MCP server, provided by IT.

api_key.title: VenCap API Key
api_key.description: Pre-configured by IT. Stored securely on this computer and never shown to Claude.
